rule_semantics.run_length: sum over variable_runs entries of (at + element_length), plus the tail of the last entry for that slot
rule_semantics.at: constant filler bytes from the current cursor to the start of this element; the cursor starts at the beginning of the run and advances past each element
rule_semantics.tail: constant bytes from the end of this element to the end of the run; only the last entry for a slot carries a non-zero tail
rule_semantics.string: ff fe ff <u8 units> then units UTF-16LE code units, so 4 + 2*units; ff fe ff ff <u16 units> then 6 + 2*units
rule_semantics.count: count_width bytes of count at the cursor, then stride bytes per element, so count_width + stride*count
rule_semantics.conditional: predicate_width bytes read at predicate_at relative to the cursor; the element is width bytes when the value is in values and 0 bytes otherwise; predicate_at bytes are part of at
rule_semantics.opaque: length is not computable from the bytes at hand; a segmenter must refuse rather than guess
rule_semantics.groups: an ordered chain of counted child groups for a class whose body is a sequence of loops rather than a fixed slot list; each group reads its count out of the stream at count.back bytes ahead of its first element as a count.width scalar, walks that many copies of element, and consumes trailer bytes after the last one
rule_semantics.repeat: a group whose element count is a constant rather than a stream field
rule_semantics.element_by_version: a group element whose runs differ per document version, keyed by the exact version the stream carries, falling through to element when the version is not named

sgSketch.repeat_note: sgSketch does not have a fixed child arity and its children are not one repeated template either: the body is an ordered chain of counted loops, each with its own count read out of the stream just ahead of it, its own multi child element, and its own trailing filler. sgSketch::Serialize at 0x4c5d28c0 reads the counts itself and delegates the tagged reads: specialised to document version 18000 it holds 68 do/while loops and 41 scalar reads but only four tagged reads, and each loop is opened by a su_CArchive::AR_get_int or AR_get_ushort that also sizes the destination array immediately before the loop, exactly as at lines 630, 635 and 667 of the specialised body, while the loop body calls FUN_4c5d0b70, FUN_4c5cc540, FUN_4c5e1e30 and friends to do the ReadObject work. That is why the rsp column of the traces places every ReadObject one and two frames below sgSketch::Serialize and yet the counts are still in sgSketch::Serialize's own frame, and why the count of each group sits a fixed distance ahead of the group rather than at a fixed offset in the lead. FUN_4c5e1e30, the single dimension list callee, shows the same shape one level down: fourteen AR_get_ushort reads, each immediately driving a do/while whose body is one ReadObject. The six groups below reproduce the child offsets of all twenty traced sgSketch instances whose scopes are fully derivable, at document versions 14000 and 18000, with zero residual against the recorded scope_end. The four instances not counted stop on an sgExtEnt_c or moSketchExtRef_w run that no trace resolves, not on a group, and every child they do reach lands on a recorded tag offset. The counts are shipped as u16 because that is the only width the point group admits at its offset; the relation, constraint and chain counts admit either two or four bytes there, since no traced instance carries a count above 4.

groups.name: entity
groups.note: the entity loop. Each element is four tagged reads: two null slots that carry an 8 byte and a 39 byte run, the entity handle, and the entity itself whose 87 byte run closes with the inline moLineViz_c record the 0x800 < version gate takes. The count is the u16 EntityCount at offset 0 of the 49 byte lead, which is 49 bytes ahead of the first element. Across the traced instances counts 1 and 4 are witnessed.

groups.name: point
groups.note: the sketch point loop. Each element is two tagged reads with an 8 byte and an 80 byte run. The count is the u16 that sits 12 bytes ahead of the loop, inside the 35 byte record that closes the last entity, and the four trailing bytes of the entity group separate them. Across the traced instances counts 0 and 5 are witnessed.

groups.name: relation
groups.note: the first relation loop. Each element is four tagged reads: a null slot with no run, a 16 byte handle record, a 17 byte record at document version 18000 and 16 bytes at 14000, and the relation handle followed by 4 bytes. The count is the u16 6 bytes ahead of the loop, inside the 13 byte run that closes the point group. Across the traced instances counts 1 and 4 are witnessed.

groups.name: constraint
groups.note: the second relation loop, read as nine tagged reads per element with the runs 0, 16, 17, 0, 4, 26, 0, 0 and 6. The count is the u16 6 bytes ahead of the loop. Only document version 18000 exercises this loop in the traces, so its element is not version gated; the 14000 parts all carry a count of zero here. Across the traced instances counts 0 and 1 are witnessed.

groups.name: lists
groups.note: the two suObList children the sketch always reads after the relation loops, with the 170 byte and 38 byte runs that separate them. Both carry their own u16 element count in their own lead, so the segmenter descends into them; every traced instance holds zero elements in the first and zero or one in the second.

groups.name: chain
groups.note: the sketch chain loop. Each element is a single moSketchChain_c with no run of its own, and the group closes with 21 bytes. The count is the u16 4 bytes ahead of the loop, inside the 38 byte run that follows the second suObList. Across the traced instances counts 0 and 1 are witnessed.

moDefaultRefPlnData_c.serialize: sldmodu.dll 0x4c2d1cf0, which calls su_CObject::Serialize and then tail-jumps through virtual slot 0x150

variable_runs.note: 48 bytes are two f64[3] vectors, the plane origin and its normal. The u8 at +48 is 1 when a 9-double row-major orthonormal basis follows and 0 when it is omitted. Measured lead is 114 for the first moDefaultRefPlnData_c of every one of the 9 traced parts, whose normal is +Z (Front, the identity basis), and 186 for the second and third, whose normals are +Y and +X. The 66-byte tail is four f64 then a u8 then four f64.

moCompFeature_c.note: The only slot holds this class single child, a classref to moUnitComponent_c that the traces record as external#43 in eight parts and external#45 in vendor_cojinete. re/data/external_classes.json slot component measures that class at own_body_lengths [0] with one nested object reference of traced_span_lengths [2], so the whole child subtree is 4 bytes: 2 for the classref tag, 0 of own body and 2 for the object reference. The traced scope from the end of this class own tag is 93 bytes in the 18000-era authored parts and 89 bytes in the 13000/14000-era vendor parts, so run 0 is 93 - 4 = 89 at document version 18000 and 89 - 4 = 85 at 14000 and 13000. Consecutive instances are 119 bytes apart in the authored parts and 115 in the vendor parts, so the array length is 93 + 119*(n-1) or 89 + 115*(n-1) by generation. moCompFeature_c::Serialize itself contributes at most two i32 flags, both gated on moArchiveHelper_c::hasCondition bits set by the caller rather than by the stream, and then FUN_4bbb16e0, which for ver >= 0x4a5 reads only the i32 tree node id and a su_CTime, 8 bytes, matching the id at end-8 and the time_t at end-4. The length is gated on the document version rather than on a positional predicate because a predicate inside this run would have to be read at an offset that depends on the run length being computed.

moProfileFeature_c.note: The generated table derived repeat_prefix 6 from the 6x2, 10x13 child count split and appended a ... slot, which made the segmenter refuse the run after slot 5 in every instance and cost every object past the sketch. The ten slots are declared here instead, because moOriginProfileFeature_c is confirmed with exactly ten fixed child slots and the same runs lead 0, 0 4, 1 47, 2 30, 3 44, 4 4, 5 0, 6 0, 7 0, 8 14, 9 8, and every single feature part in the corpus carries the same ten children in the same order with those same runs, with sgLineHandle in slot 6 where the origin class takes a wildcard. Declaring them takes boss1_front_rect_blind from 148 to 223 objects and the 32 donor fixtures from 5244 to 7257. The class stays partial rather than confirmed because two traced instances carry only 6 children, so ten is the arity of the single feature family and not yet a proven invariant of the class; those two instances stop on the run after their last child instead of being walked to the end.
